_comment: Prices per 1,000,000 tokens, copied by hand from the provider's official pricing page (paid Standard tier). Every entry needs source_url and the date you read it (retrieved). A model without an entry has no price: its cost is reported as unknown and --max-cost refuses to run. Never guess a price; re-check the page before a paid run, because prices change. Optional keys: cached_input, tier_threshold_tokens, input_above_threshold, output_above_threshold, cached_input_above_threshold. Optional valid_until (YYYY-MM-DD): after that date --max-cost refuses to use the entry (v0.14.1).

models.note: Standard paid tier, text input; output price includes thinking tokens. The page states these prices apply through 2026-12-31 and rise to input 1.50 / output 7.50 / cached 0.15 from 2027-01-01. A free tier exists; usage on it is not billed, so computed costs are what the same usage costs on the paid tier.
